subject: Urgent: TTL misalignment — request to hold upcoming purge and temporary retention hold
messages:
From: ops@nimbuscloud.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Nimbus backup purge alert — potential early purge for customer Acme Health

Hi Karthik / Kimberly,

We're opening this thread because our automated purge job (scheduled for 2027-05-03 02:00 UTC) has flagged a configuration mismatch for Acme Health's backup bucket. It looks like a TTL parameter was accidentally set to 30 days rather than the agreed 90 days for one subprocessor namespace (logs/logstream-*/). If the purge runs it will permanently delete snapshots that are still within Acme's contractual retention window under section 4 of the DPA.

Immediate ask: can Redwood confirm whether we should halt the May 3 purge for Acme Health while we investigate? We can pause the job on our side but need explicit confirmation from the account owner / legal hold to avoid drift in the schedule.

Attachments: purge_plan_may3.pdf (stub)

Apologies for the alarm — we're isolating the affected namespace now and will provide a list of impacted objects within 2 hours.

— Nimbus Ops
ops@nimbuscloud.com
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: ops@nimbuscloud.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, legal@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-05-01T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus backup purge alert — potential early purge for customer Acme Health

Thanks for the heads up and for isolating the namespace. Kimberly / Laura — looping you in for compliance + account decisions.

Karthik here (account lead for Acme Health). Do NOT run the scheduled purge for Acme on May 3 until we confirm. Kimberly, can you confirm whether this constitutes a DPA breach trigger or if a temporary retention hold is sufficient?

Ops: please attach the list of affected snapshot IDs, their creation timestamps, and which subprocessor host(s) are involved. We also need evidence that the TTL change was accidental (config diff) and a proposed rollback plan. Acme's legal is CC'd; we'll need written acknowledgement from them to authorize any destructive action.

For internal context: Acme's DPA (Section 4) requires 90-day retention for production logs unless otherwise agreed. If snapshots within the 90-day window are at risk, we need to treat this as a compliance incident and preserve evidence for audit.

I'll coordinate an immediate temporary retention hold with Acme legal once we have the impacted object list.

Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: ops@nimbuscloud.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, legal@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-05-01T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus backup purge alert — potential early purge for customer Acme Health

Acknowledged. This is being treated as a compliance incident. Immediate actions from Redwood side:

- Instruct Nimbus to PLACE A TEMPORARY HOLD on the May 3 purge for the Acme tenant (do not run any destructive jobs).
- Provide a CSV with affected snapshot IDs, creation times, TTL value in effect, and the subprocessor host/service.
- We will open an internal JIRA (INF-2209) and notify Engineering Ops for an emergency rollback/restore plan.
- Ask Acme legal to confirm in writing whether they'll accept a temporary escrow snapshot and to acknowledge the incident.

Required from Nimbus: config diff showing when TTL was changed, the user/service that made the change, and any automated job that might have applied the TTL.

Proposed temporary mitigation steps (high level):
1) Pause purge scheduler for tenant
2) Snapshot affected objects to immutable escrow if possible
3) Provide audit logs for chain-of-custody
4) Reconfigure TTL to agreed value and validate

I have attached a short rollback checklist for Ops (rollback_steps.md).

Kimberly Park
Head of Trust & Safety, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: ops@nimbuscloud.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: support@logstream.com, legal@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-05-01T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus backup purge alert — potential early purge for customer Acme Health

Thanks — attaching the requested list. Summary:
- Affected snapshots: 34 objects under namespace logs/logstream-acme-*/ (attached: affected_snapshots.csv)
- TTL currently set: 30 days (changed on 2027-04-28T03:14:22 UTC)
- Change origin: intermittent automation run from a third-party agent tied to LogStream Inc. We have opened a ticket with them; cc'd their support.
- Region: eu-west-1 (all objects located in customer EU bucket)

We can pause the purge scheduler immediately — instructed operations to set hold flag. We can also create immutable escrow snapshots and will deliver the audit snapshot (audit_snapshot_2027-05-01.log) by EOD.

Question for Redwood: do you want us to proceed with creating escrow snapshots and keep them for 30 days while you coordinate with Acme legal, or do you require us to hold them until written authorization (DocuSign) is received? Escrow will incur storage costs; we can tag with a short-lived retention policy if you authorize.

Attachments: affected_snapshots.csv, audit_snapshot_2027-05-01.log

— Nimbus Ops
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, ops@nimbuscloud.com
Cc: legal@acmehealth.com, engineering-ops@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus backup purge alert — potential early purge for customer Acme Health

Good work triaging this quickly. Final decisions and next steps: 

1) HOLD: Do not run the May 3 purge for Acme Health. Nimbus — keep the scheduler paused and do not perform any destructive operations until we confirm in writing.
2) ESCROW: Proceed to create immutable escrow snapshots for the 34 affected objects. Store them under an escrow namespace and preserve them for 60 days or until Acme provides written instructions (whichever is longer). We will cover reasonable short-term storage costs — Ops to log costs to INF-2209.
3) EVIDENCE PACKET: Nimbus to deliver the audit_snapshot_2027-05-01.log and config diff (who/when changed TTL). Attach that packet to JIRA INF-2209.
4) ACME ACK: Acme Legal (cc'd) — please confirm by return email whether you accept the escrow arrangement and whether Redwood may perform any remediation (rollback of TTL) on your behalf. If Acme requires a signed acknowledgement, please use the DocuSign link provided.

Engineering-ops: please begin a root-cause remediation for the automation rule that applied incorrect TTLs to LogStream namespaces. We will need telemetry and regression tests to prevent recurrence.

I'll mark this a priority incident; Kimberly, please prepare a short incident summary for legal/compliance and retention reporting. Karthik — keep the account updated and include any cost implications.

Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success & Trust, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
